title: An opening title page keeps its dissolve onto the recording when its fade out changes
goal: After a title page at the start pushes the recording later, making the page's fade out longer or shorter keeps the dissolve exactly over the recording's start, so a longer dissolve never dims the page toward black before the recording arrives.
notes: Follow-up from a-title-page-at-the-start-pushes-the-recording-a. Insert pushes everything later by page length less its fade out (PhotonzDocument.pushPictureAfterOpeningTitle in TitlePresets.swift), so at the default 0.5s the recording starts at 3.5s under a 3.5-4.0 fade. Reproduced: /tmp/tp-fade-probe.json (title-pages-and-name-cards-walk up to 2-title-page, then rightClick 'Timing Title Page' > 'Fade Out > 1s', home, step to 3.25s, snapshot). Scripts/playtest.sh /tmp/tp-fade-probe.json --no-build -> status ok; at-3-25-sc.png shows the page at about 75% over an empty black frame with the recording still to start at 3.5s. Premiere would grow a dissolve at the cut out of the title's handle, Final Cut likewise; the obvious model is: when a page at 0 has a picture clip starting exactly at out minus its old fade, a fade change moves that clip and everything after by the difference. Same family: Ripple Delete on the opening page leaves the recording at 3.5s with black before it (rippleDeleteLayer closes only what starts at or after the page's end); worth folding into the same change.
acceptance: Setting Fade Out to 1s on a title page that opened the recording leaves the recording starting where the fade begins, in one undo step
Between the page's fade start and the recording's start there is no frame of the page over an empty frame
A page placed by hand elsewhere keeps today's behavior: its fade changes nothing else

log.note: Reproduced first: /tmp/tp-fade-probe.json at 3.25s showed the page dimming over black, recording still at 3.5s. Before-build review: Premiere/Final Cut grow a dissolve at the cut out of the title's handle; the model here moves the recording and everything after it to the new fade start (keepOpeningDissolve in TitlePresets.swift), only for a non-picture layer at 0:00 with an unlocked picture starting exactly at out minus its old fade (openingDissolveStartMS). setPictureFade routes through it, so the right-click menu, the panel's Fade Out, the bar's corner drag and the transition picker's fade all follow; insertTitle uses the raw fadePicture so its own push is unchanged. Nothing moves when a moved clip would land on one that stays on the same track. Ripple Delete on such a page closes from the dissolve start, so the recording is back at 0:00 (folded in from the notes).

Verified: 7 new tests in TitlePageAtStartTests.swift (OpeningTitleDissolveTests) fail without the change and pass with it; Scripts/test.sh 11211 tests green. New walk Scripts/playtest/opening-title-dissolve-walk.json (no flags) checks the recording's start at 3.5 -> 3.0 (Fade Out > 1s) -> 3.5 (one Undo) -> 3.75 (0.25s) -> 0.0 (Ripple Delete), b-roll moving with it; ok with 4 real captures. title-pages-and-name-cards-walk ok.

left rough: dragging the fade-out corner on the page's bar moves the recording only on release (ClipPiecesBar commits on onEnded); the shading follows the hand. Not filed: one-step change, nobody has hit it, and it lands in the audit's evaluate for the user to weigh.

Changing the fade out on an opening title page moves the recording and everything after it to where the fade begins (one undo step); Ripple Delete on that page puts the recording back at 0:00; a page elsewhere changes only its own fade. Core: openingDissolveStartMS/keepOpeningDissolve in TitlePresets.swift, routed through setPictureFade and rippleDeleteLayer. Verified by 7 new tests (failing first), full suite green, and the new opening-title-dissolve-walk at Next defaults (4 real captures). Audit: queue/audits/2026-10-04-opening-title-dissolve.json
